title: Lectio actuum apostolorum (Mouton)
desc: Jean Mouton, Lectio actuum apostolorum. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
